+    },

+      "metric": "Annual motorist deaths divided by annual cyclist deaths",
+      "denominator": "Cyclist deaths in the same year",
+      "grouping": "Year",
+      "chart_type": "Single-series line chart with equality reference line",
+      "reason": "A ratio shows the relative scale of motorist deaths compared with cyclist deaths across years.",
+      "probability": 0.20,
+      "answer": "Motorist deaths were 2.65 to 10 times cyclist deaths across the years, with the lowest ratio in 2019 and highest in 2013.",

It is defensible for comparing relative differences when the category totals are far apart.
